admission_evidence.completeness_rule: Fetch complete snapshot with stable location_id ordering and total_count consistency

invariants.cold_start_relocation_protection: When relocation is detected on cold start without upstream migration moment, valid_from reflects snapshot observation time rather than backdating new coordinates to installation date
invariants.transition_gap_preservation: Upstream absence of relocation moment preserves the unknown interval between versions without fabricating an effective start date
invariants.baseline_evidence_requirement: Without an explicit official validity timestamp, coordinates start at their first observed published snapshot; installation dates and text notes do not establish past coordinate validity
invariants.closed_interval_output: Closed historical versions are emitted in output bundle alongside current location versions to maintain downstream historical observation joins
